newsitem.title: CANADA: QLT stock climbs on European drug deal.
newsitem.headline: QLT stock climbs on European drug deal.

text.p: QLT PhotoTherapeutics Inc stock jumped Thursday on news of the biotechnology company's European drug licensing deal with the Speywood Pharmaceuticals Ltd unit of France's Beaufour Ipsen.
QLT shares climbed 1.15 to 27.75 in Toronto.
A QLT spokeswoman attributed the rise to the announcement. "This is very, very good news," she said.

The licensing deal, announced Wednesday, entails Speywood acquiring exclusive European marketing and distribution rights to QLT's light-activated cancer drug Photofrin and one of QLT's second-generation compounds.
Although the companies did not name the second compound, analysts believe it is BPD which they expect to be first used for treatment of eye disease.
For those rights Beaufour Ipsen will provide up to C$38.3 million in access fees, milestone payments and research funds. QLT will make the drugs and Beaufour will pay QLT a royalty.
In addition, Beafour is buying C$6.8 million worth of QLT shares at C$34.54 each and a warrant for C$6.8 million more shares.
